title: The Glass Rain Planet
hook: You are looking at a deep blue planet that is actually hell.
script: You are looking at a deep blue planet that is actually hell. From a distance, HD 189733b looks like a peaceful water world. One side is trapped in eternal daylight, while the other is frozen in permanent night. This temperature gap creates a nightmare. The blue color comes from clouds of silicate glass. Winds reach 8,000 kilometres per hour, which is seven times the speed of sound. It is the deadliest sight in the galaxy. A world that looks like home, but feels like a furnace.
